target.label: A settings screen you can navigate, trust, and verify

rationale: P0 coverage is 100% and overall coverage is 91% (minimum 80%), but P1 coverage is 86% (target 90%). Both shortfalls sit in Story 5.1: 5.1-AC4 and 5.1-AC6 are verified by asserting strings in JavaScript and CSS source rather than by exercising behaviour (no browser/E2E layer). Caveat: the integration suite carrying most of this evidence was order-dependent at trace time, so coverage was scored on isolated runs.
